headline: Jay-Z picks the halftime act every year. This year: Jay-Z.
summary: The NFL said Monday that Jay-Z will play the Super Bowl halftime show on February 14 near Los Angeles. His company Roc Nation has produced the show since 2019 and he helps choose each performer, but he has never taken the stage himself. Roger Goodell says that was his one request from the start. Jay-Z called it a dream come true.
cover_answer: He did. The NFL boss asked him to, years ago.
table_question: If you ran the contest, could you ever enter it yourself?

5-7.script: Every year a famous singer plays a concert in the middle of the Super Bowl, the biggest football game in America. For seven years a rapper called Jay-Z has helped pick who sings. This February it's his turn. Tens of millions of people will watch on TV, more than could ever fit in the stadium.
5-7.why: One big game, one concert, one turn. The TV crowd is what they can picture.
5-7.why_long: A six-year-old reasons from what is in front of them, so the script gives one game, one concert and one turn after seven years of picking other people. The crowd on TV that could never fit in the stadium is the anchor. Expect "can we watch it?" Yes. February 14, in the middle of the game.

8-12.script: Jay-Z's company has produced the Super Bowl halftime show since 2019 and he helps pick the act. He never played it. NFL boss Roger Goodell says his one request was that Jay-Z take the stage. Monday the NFL set it: February 14. A coach putting himself in the game.
8-12.why: Seven years picking others, then himself.
8-12.why_long: This age is testing whether adults apply the rules fairly, so the script runs the chain: produce the show, pick the act for seven years, never take it, then take it with the boss's blessing. The coach putting himself in is the mechanism. Expect "isn't that cheating?" Not if the boss asked. Say if you'd have waited seven years.

13-17.script: Is it fair to pick yourself for the biggest stage in music? Jay-Z has helped choose the halftime act since 2019 and never took the slot. Goodell says asking him was his one request at the start. Second: he played that same stadium last weekend, 30 years after his first album. A reward, or the plan all along?
13-17.why: Reward or the plan all along. Let them argue it.
13-17.why_long: A teenager can hold two true things at once: he picked himself, and the man who runs the league says he asked him to. The script hands them both and the 30-year anniversary, and asks reward or plan. Expect "would you pick yourself?" Answer honestly. Kuhn says arguing is a skill you practise, and this one has no stakes.

5-7.a: A concert in the middle of the biggest football game of the year. Tens of millions of people watch it.

8-12.a: He did. The NFL boss says he asked him to, back in 2019.
Nobody has said. The NFL says she'll top the guessing list.

13-17.q: Isn't it unfair that he chose himself?
13-17.a: The NFL says it asked him to in 2019. He waited seven years.

13-17.q: Why does anyone care who plays?
13-17.a: Kendrick Lamar's 2025 show was the most watched halftime ever. It won an Emmy.
